|game_text=Unless your [Reflections 3] Objective on table, deploy on table. [[Vader's Obsession]] may be played to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Mara is present with [[Luke (V){{!}}Luke]], each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1). Add character's ability. If Karrde on table, your total is -1. Higher total wins. If Luke loses, place him out of play and you may retrieve 5 Force. If Mara loses, cross her to the Light Side (she is now Mara Skywalker). Unless duel canceled or tied, for remainder of game any Mara is ability = 6, adds one battle destiny, and once per battle involving her, may cancel one just drawn destiny.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Deep Hatred (V)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-36-Deep_Hatred-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-36-Deep_Hatred.png]]) and the Master List slip show the original text (see [[Deep Hatred (V)]]). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-deephatred-pre.gif]]) prints a third wording that is in neither version: it has no “After the duel (unless it was canceled or tied)” and no “Unless duel canceled or tied, for remainder of game any”, and ends “… (she is now Mara Skywalker). Mara is ability = 6, adds one battle destiny, and once per battle involving her, may cancel one just drawn destiny.” It has no page of its own; whether it records a separate printing is a question for Bill (8 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Deep Hatred (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 36)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Unless your [Reflections 3] objective on table, deploy on table. Vader's Obsession may be played to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Mara is present with Luke, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1). Add character's ability. If Karrde on table, your total is -1. Higher total wins. If Luke loses, place him out of play and you may retrieve 5 Force. If Mara loses, cross her to the Light Side (she is now Mara Skywalker). After the duel (unless it was canceled or tied) Mara is ability = 6, adds one battle destiny, and once per battle involving her, may cancel one just drawn destiny.” The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> That copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) capitalised “Objective” and changed “After the duel (unless it was canceled or tied) Mara is ability = 6” to “Unless duel canceled or tied, for remainder of game any Mara is ability = 6”: “Unless your [Reflections 3] Objective on table, deploy on table. Vader's Obsession may be played to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Mara is present with Luke, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1). Add character's ability. If Karrde on table, your total is -1. Higher total wins. If Luke loses, place him out of play and you may retrieve 5 Force. If Mara loses, cross her to the Light Side (she is now Mara Skywalker). Unless duel canceled or tied, for remainder of game any Mara is ability = 6, adds one battle destiny, and once per battle involving her, may cancel one just drawn destiny.”<ref name="cl-1240_37-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013)</ref>
